title: Papa's AutoPay
hook: Rs 199 a month. Papa deleted the app.

beats.say: Papa pays one ninety nine rupees a month. He deleted the app in March.
beats.show: Papa pays Rs 199 a month. He deleted the app in March.

screen.title: Mum
screen.body: Beta Papa ke account se har mahine 199 kat raha hai. App to delete kar diya tha??

beats.say: How does Papa feel about it? I made five headings. Would you like me to expand?
Easy! Deleting the app never stops the monthly payment!

screen.title: Stop an AutoPay
screen.body:
Deleting the app never stops AutoPay.

1. Open the UPI app Papa paid with
2. Profile > AutoPay (or Mandates)
3. Tap it > Cancel
4. Also check Play Store > Payments & subscriptions

beats.say: Done! I checked his whole account. Papa has four AutoPays!

caption:
rs 199 a month for an app papa deleted in march. the committee found three more.

deleting an app never stops its autopay. open the upi app he paid with, go to autopay or mandates and cancel it, then check play store > payments and subscriptions.
